registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Control register. Bit 0 enables PWM operation; all other bits are reserved and read as zero.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: When 1, the PWM counter is allowed to run if PERIOD is nonzero. When 0, the counter holds at zero and pwm_out is low.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved bits. Always read as 0 and ignore writes.

registers.name: DUTY_CYCLE
registers.description: PWM duty-cycle compare threshold. The output is high while enabled and counter_value is less than this value.

fields.name: DUTY_CYCLE
fields.description: 8-bit duty threshold. pwm_out is high when ENABLE=1 and counter_value < DUTY_CYCLE.

registers.name: PERIOD
registers.description: PWM period terminal count. The counter increments while enabled and wraps to zero when it reaches this value.

fields.name: PERIOD
fields.description: 8-bit terminal count. When ENABLE=1 and PERIOD!=0, the counter increments each clock and wraps to zero upon reaching PERIOD. When PERIOD=0, the counter holds at zero and pwm_out remains low.

registers.name: COUNTER_VALUE
registers.description: Live counter status register. Reflects the current internal counter value and is read-only.

fields.name: COUNTER_VALUE
fields.description: Live 8-bit counter state. Reads return the current counter value. Writes have no effect.

init_sequence: Program DUTY_CYCLE with the desired threshold.
Program PERIOD with the desired terminal count.
Set CONTROL.ENABLE to 1 to start PWM operation.
polling_sequence: Read COUNTER_VALUE at 0x0C if live counter status is required.
Read CONTROL, DUTY_CYCLE, or PERIOD to verify programmed values as needed.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register interface is a simple custom 8-bit memory-mapped bus implied by the provided wr_en/rd_en, address, and data ports.
No additional hierarchy, bus protocol, or interrupt behavior is introduced.
All register addresses are byte offsets: 0x00, 0x04, 0x08, and 0x0C.
